work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCLX (protocol LF45173–45174) approves the arrangement with Ferdinand II by which Sicilian estates of the see of Malta compensate the Benedictine monastery of Catania for its Maltese and Gozitan lands, and ends with its own 30 August 1833 closing at LF45308–45311, before numeral CCLXI at LF45314. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF45173–45173; the source closing at LF45308–45311 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio~ rem sub annulo piscatoris die trigesima augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pon- tificatus Nostri anno tertio, At LF45236 the OCR reads superextantes cos fun , red- where the native WORDs leave an 85 px gap between fun (x2179–2246) and the comma (x2331): glyphs of one printed word are unrecognized, but no whole word or line is missing or displaced; the token is retained literally as misread OCR. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
